terms.gloss: fit out, equip, provide with what is needed; adorn, decorate; honour
evidence: Liv. 9.40: scūta ad forum ōrnandum (Lewis & Short)

terms.gloss: fitted out, equipped, well furnished; adorned, handsome
evidence: Cic. Fin. 2.112: sapiēns plūrimīs artibus īnstrūctus et ōrnātus (Lewis & Short)

phrases.latin: ōrnanda enim est dignitās domō, nōn ex domō tōta quaerenda
phrases.english: a man’s standing should be set off by his house, not sought wholly from it

phrases.latin: agrō bene cultō nihil potest esse nec ūsū ūberius nec speciē ōrnātius
phrases.english: nothing can be richer in use or handsomer to look at than a well-tilled field

sources: Lewis & Short: orno
